issues.title: Wire GossipSub into accumulated integration
issues.description: Wire GossipSub networking into the DAG-BFT service in accumulated. Currently service.go passes nil,nil to consensus.NewNode() for host and pubsub, which disables multi-node networking. Fix: 1) Add Host() method to p2p.Node, 2) Create GossipSub in dagbft.go, 3) Pass to ServiceConfig, 4) Pass to consensus.NewNode in service.go

issues.title: EXECUTE 7-node integration test (30 min, 1000 TPS)
issues.description:
**THIS IS AN EXECUTION TASK, NOT A CODE-WRITING TASK.**

You must ACTUALLY RUN a 30-minute integration test, not just write test code.

## REQUIRED STEPS:

### 1. Merge dagbft-integration into this branch
```bash
cd /home/paul/worktrees/accumulate-dagbft/issue-3823
git fetch origin
git merge origin/dagbft-integration
go build ./...  # MUST PASS
```

### 2. Start 7 nodes in tmux session 'dagbft-test'
Create tmux session with 7 windows, one node per window. Each node must:
- Use DAG-BFT consensus (not CometBFT)
- Connect to the other 6 nodes via GossipSub
- Log to /tmp/node-N.log

### 3. Run load generator at 1000 TPS for 30 ACTUAL MINUTES
- Submit mixed transactions (transfers, creates, data entries)
- Log backpressure events (ErrBackpressure count)
- Sample memory every 30 seconds

### 4. After 30 minutes, collect results:
- Block heights from all 7 nodes (must match within 1-2)
- BPT/state roots from all 7 nodes (must match)
- Total transactions submitted vs committed
- Memory usage start vs end
- Any crashes or errors

### 5. Create results document
Write docs-dev/results/issue-3823-results.md with ACTUAL DATA from the test run.

## SUCCESS CRITERIA (must verify with real data):
- [ ] All 7 nodes ran for full 30 minutes without crash
- [ ] Block heights match across nodes
- [ ] BPT roots match across nodes
- [ ] Backpressure returned errors (not silent drops)
- [ ] Sustained >= 500 TPS
- [ ] Memory growth < 1GB per node

## DO NOT mark complete unless you have:
1. Actually run the test for 30 minutes
2. Collected real metrics from the running nodes
3. Documented results with actual numbers
